summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares Enhanced International Active ETF (ENHI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of international large- and mid-cap stocks. The selection and weighting of positions is based on quantitative models and big data to seek above average performance. ENHI was launched on Mar 10, 2026 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: ENHI is an equity ETF with a total of 594 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 3.20%, Shell at 1.59%, HSBC Holdings at 1.59%, Roche Holding AG at 1.49%, and Siemens Aktiengesellschaft at 1.29%.
